name: claude-cli
title: CLI Assistant
description: Ask, chat, translate and rewrite selected text without Raycast Pro, using the Claude Code or Codex CLI signed in with your own subscription.
author: umitaltintas

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Ask a question and get a streamed answer. Works as a fallback command.

commands.name: ask-selection
commands.title: Ask About Selection
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Ask a question about the selected text.

commands.name: ask-files
commands.title: Ask About Selected Files
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Ask a question about the files or folders selected in Finder or File Explorer. The model can read them, nothing else; turn on Tools on the answer for shell commands.

commands.name: fix-grammar
commands.title: Fix Spelling and Grammar
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Fix spelling and grammar in the selected text and paste it back.

commands.name: improve-writing
commands.title: Improve Writing
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Make the selected text clearer and paste it back.

commands.name: make-shorter
commands.title: Make Shorter
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Shorten the selected text and paste it back.

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Translate as you type; selected text is filled in. The target language is remembered.

commands.name: translate-replace
commands.title: Translate and Replace
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Translate the selected text into the last used language and paste it back.

commands.name: summarize
commands.title: Summarize
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Summarize the selected text; a selected link is opened with web search.

commands.name: explain
commands.title: Explain
commands.subtitle: CLI Assistant
commands.description: Explain the selected text or code.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Used until you pick a model in the extension. Claude aliases always resolve to the newest version. The full lists from the Claude Code and Codex CLIs are in the model menus: Chat, Translate, and ⌘⇧R (Ctrl+Shift+R on Windows) on answers.

preferences.name: primaryLanguage
preferences.title: Primary Language
preferences.description: Your main language. Summaries and explanations of selected text are written in it, and Translate's Auto mode translates into it.

preferences.name: secondaryLanguage
preferences.title: Secondary Language
preferences.description: Translate's Auto mode translates text that is already in your primary language into this one.

preferences.name: webSearch
preferences.title: Web Search
preferences.label: Search the web in Ask AI, Ask About Selection and Chat
preferences.description: Default for Ask AI, Ask About Selection and new chats; toggle it in a chat or on an answer with ⌘⇧W (Ctrl+Shift+W on Windows). Answers that search the web take longer (Claude ~20 s, Codex ~13 s).

preferences.name: chatTools
preferences.title: Tools
preferences.label: Let Ask AI and Chat read files and run shell commands you approve
preferences.description: Default for Ask AI and new chats; toggle it in a chat or on an answer with ⌘⇧T (Ctrl+Shift+T on Windows). Files are read without asking. A shell command that changes something waits for your approval; Claude Code then runs it and goes on. Codex shows it after the answer and runs it once you approve.

preferences.name: claudeAutoMode
preferences.label: Claude Code auto mode: run commands it judges safe without asking
preferences.description: With Tools, Claude Code's own check runs commands that fit your request (including ones that change files) without asking; it still asks about the rest. Off: every command that changes something asks first.

preferences.name: effort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: How hard the model thinks, for every command. Higher is slower; short questions rarely need it. Change it in a chat or on an answer with ⌘⇧E (Ctrl+Shift+E on Windows).

preferences.name: customModels
preferences.title: Extra Models
preferences.description: Comma-separated models missing from your plan's list (e.g. claude-opus-5-5[1m]). The list itself comes from the Claude Code CLI automatically.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to try ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin (on Windows: ~/.local/bin/claude.exe, then PATH).

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI Path
preferences.description: Leave empty to try Homebrew, ~/.local/bin, npm and the copy bundled with the ChatGPT app (on Windows: the codex.exe inside the global npm package, then PATH).

preferences.name: extraInstructions
preferences.title: Extra Instructions
preferences.description: Appended to the system prompt of every request (tone, how to address you, etc.).
